args.text: Implemented the final agreed policy in webhooks/retry.py: 4 retries, 3s base delay, exponential backoff, capped at 60s. Verified the constants and backoff/cap with direct Python assertions (zero-based attempts: 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 60, 60, 60 seconds). `python -m pytest -q` found no tests in this checkout, so there was no existing suite to run. This confirms the local code change, not a deployment.
